entries.source: Regesten der Pfalzgrafen am Rhein 1214 - 1508. Karlsr. Coph. 464,33v.
entries.german: Ruprecht verfügt, dass seine erben, falls er in fremdem lande stürbe und Conrad von Rosenberg sein vitztum zu Amberg noch am leben, demselben, ehe er seines amtes entsetzt, 400 pfund heller geben sollen.
entries.english: Ruprecht decrees that his heirs, in case he should die in a foreign land and Konrad von Rosenberg, his viztame¹ at Amberg, is still alive, shall give to the same [Konrad], before he is removed from his office, 400 pounds of Heller.

facts.content: directed his heirs to pay Konrad von Rosenberg 400 pounds Heller if he died abroad while Konrad was still alive.
was to receive 400 pounds Heller before being removed from office if Ruprecht died abroad while Konrad was still alive.
